passes.prompt:
PRE-PRODUCTION ANATOMY BLOCKING PASS, not final artwork. Input 1 is the locked landscape plate: retain its camera, terrain, trees, path, light and framing. Add ONLY the specified cast at the target positions.
Render characters as smooth matte clay animation maquettes with simplified identifiable animal shapes, no detailed fur. PinPin: compact low horizontal hedgehog body with domed quill mass indicated by shallow grooves, cream muzzle, small round ears, dark natural eye and black nose, no stray dot between eye and nose. Lulu: pale-gray natural rabbit, white muzzle, pink inner ears, low crouched body and compact haunches. Tawny: smaller brown rabbit, cream muzzle, darker ear tips. NO clothes, shoes, human torso or human hands. No golden spine on head or back.
CRITICAL: each animal has exactly FOUR anatomical limbs: two attached to the SHOULDERS at the front of the ribcage and two to the HIPS at the rear. Color each WHOLE limb from its root to its paw continuously: animal's LEFT foreleg CORAL RED; RIGHT foreleg CYAN BLUE; LEFT hindleg VIOLET; RIGHT hindleg YELLOW. Neutral body stays uncolored. No fifth limb, chest arm, duplicate paw, disconnected colored stump or leg-shaped tail. Short natural legs, no bipedal running. Far-side limbs can be naturally partly occluded but must attach correctly; do not create extra limbs to make colors visible. Put subdued contact shadows under supporting paws and match scene illumination. No other cast or fauna beyond those already in plate. No text, labels, arrows or guides inside image. Landscape 1536x1024.

FINISHING PASS ONLY. Input 1 is the inspected color-coded character blocking image and fixes ALL composition, camera, character positions, sizes, silhouettes, poses, gaze directions and limb attachments. Input 2, when supplied, is a MATERIAL/IDENTITY reference only, never a pose or composition reference.
Convert the matte character maquettes into finished soft dimensional miniature storybook animals. Remove ALL diagnostic coral/cyan/violet/yellow limb colors, replacing them with natural character fur colors. PinPin has warm cream short fur on muzzle, cheeks, underside and all four paws, a soft dense brown-and-cream quill coat, small natural glossy dark eyes, small black nose, friendly quiet expression, short real animal legs and no human torso. Lulu has pale-gray soft fur, white muzzle and pink ear interiors. Tawny has warm brown soft fur, cream muzzle and darker ear tips.
DO NOT add or remove limbs; do not lengthen legs, raise body, stand rabbits like humans, add chest arms, duplicate paws, add a protruding rear stump, invent a leg-shaped tail, or change the inspected pose. Fur must follow the existing body silhouette rather than conceal or invent anatomy. Every limb retains the same shoulder/hip attachment as blocking. Keep supporting feet and their contact shadows on the same ground. No boots, clothes, head ornament, golden back quill or stray black mark on muzzle. If a small drawing tool is explicitly in blocking, preserve it only in that paw.
Preserve background plate framing, vegetation, lighting, water and landscape as closely as possible; change character materials only. Full landscape 1536x1024, no text or labels.
